sources.snippet: Qwen Studio is an AI assistant for everyone, powered by the Qwen series models. It's free to use, open to all, and ready to help with creativity, collaboration, and endless possibilities.

sources.title: Every Qwen AI Model Explained and Compared (Aug, 2026)
sources.snippet: The cheapest API tier, Qwen-Flash, is $0.05 input and $0.40 output per million tokens. Qwen splits into two halves that most guides mix up. The first half is a set of open-weight models you can download and run on your own hardware, all under the permissive Apache 2.0 license. sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract In this work, we present Qwen3, the latest version of the Qwen model family. Qwen3 comprises a series of large language models (LLMs) designed to advance performance, efficiency, and multilingual capabilities.
